info.title: CF Meet Meeting Service / Account — admin bridge operator reads
info.description: Operator reads the Meeting Service (Account authority and conferences) exposes to cfmeet.admin-bridge only (ADR 0068, design §6.1–6.2): account search and detail, sessions, devices, MFA status and security history (account.administer), meeting spaces, conferences, live conferences, participants and the conference audit (meeting.administer). Every request also needs X-CF-Operator: hq:<staff>. Served only while ADMIN_OPERATOR_API_ENABLED=true. Minimal by construction: ids, states, counts and times; never a password hash, token, session label, device key, MFA secret or recovery code, IP address, location, message content or media.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service token from packages/service-auth; audience cfmeet.meeting-service; issuer must be cfmeet.admin-bridge holding the stated permission in the receiver's trust bundle.

Operator.name: X-CF-Operator
Operator.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge reads for (ADR 0068). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge; operator attribution from any other caller is refused on every internal route of the service.

emailMasked.description: First character of the local part and of the domain label, the top-level domain kept (a***@e***.com). Never the address.
